# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Greywater Labs.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

Date: Sat 24 Aug 2030 12:20
Subject: INC-2030-007 summary: No. 50 Drumlin

Hello all,

A short summary of INC-2030-007. On 23 August 2030 the alarm on No. 50 Drumlin went off at 14:27 and we were fully back at 15:22, so the outage ran for 55 min. It was graded SEV-3. Ilse
Treasurer

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Ashgrove Public Libraries.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Corrigal Malt and Hop Works.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Lowerby Brewhouse.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Oakenshaw Theatre Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Lowerby Farmers' Union.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Inkwell Farmers' Union.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Frostholm Arts Trust.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Gullwing Health Cooperative.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Oakenshaw Heritage Railway.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.
